quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE FILM FRAMES CHRONOLOGICALLY AND ROTATE THE CRANK
quests.story: [Sub Mission 91-1] A deep sea submarine descends into the darkness. It reaches the active geothermal rift zone. The crew discovers a active field of towering chimneys.
options: Sunlight sparkles on the shallow coral.
quests.hint: Follow the sequence from descent, reaching the floor, to the final discovery of vents. (Diving calibration index 91-1)
quests.explanation: The story logically moves from diving down, entering the rift, and discovering towering chimneys. [Verified by Cinematic Sequencer Unit 91].

quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE FILM FRAMES CHRONOLOGICALLY AND ROTATE THE CRANK
quests.story: [Microbe Mission 91-2] Microbes gather around sunless vents. They perform chemical synthesis using sulfur. This supports a rich community of specialized deep sea creatures.
options: A sunless ecosystem thrives in the deep.
quests.hint: Sequence the steps starting with microbial clustering, chemical conversion, to sustaining deep life. (Diving calibration index 91-2)
quests.explanation: Bacteria cluster, produce nutrient compounds chemically, and support sunless aquatic species. [Verified by Cinematic Sequencer Unit 91].

quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE FILM FRAMES CHRONOLOGICALLY AND ROTATE THE CRANK
quests.story: [Upwell Mission 91-3] Coastal winds push surface waters away. Deep icy currents rise to replace them. Plankton blooms rapidly due to the nutrient influx.
options: Surface coastal winds push top waters.
Plankton bloom spreads in sunlit layers.
Winter snow covers the ocean surface.
quests.hint: Sequence the upwelling cycle from surface wind push, deep rising currents, to plankton growth. (Diving calibration index 91-3)
quests.explanation: Winds displace top warm layers, bringing up cold bottom nutrients that ignite marine blooms. [Verified by Cinematic Sequencer Unit 91].

quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE FILM FRAMES CHRONOLOGICALLY AND ROTATE THE CRANK
quests.story: [Biolum Mission 92-1] Deep creatures oxidize luciferin inside their organs. A cold glowing light is produced. This glowing lure attracts prey in the pitch black abyss.
options: Glowing lures attract prey in abyss.
quests.hint: Sequence the biological process from chemical oxidation, light production, to hunting prey. (Diving calibration index 92-1)
quests.explanation: Organisms oxidize chemical luciferin, generating organic glowing beacons that attract deep prey. [Verified by Cinematic Sequencer Unit 92].

quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE FILM FRAMES CHRONOLOGICALLY AND ROTATE THE CRANK
quests.story: [Kelp Mission 92-2] Giant kelp anchors to bottom rocks. Fronds grow rapidly towards solar beams. Kelp canopies form floating forests sheltering fish.
options: Kelp roots anchor to ocean bottom.
Floating canopy forests shelter marine fish.
Cold volcanic ash blankets the vents.
quests.hint: Sequence the plant development from rock anchoring, rapid vertical growth, to canopy shelter formation. (Diving calibration index 92-2)
quests.explanation: Sea plants anchor, grow rapidly upward to harness light, and construct dense canopies. [Verified by Cinematic Sequencer Unit 92].
